name: SSH authorized_keys injector
description: Installs one or more SSH public keys into a user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct 700/600 permissions. Pairs with the sshd feature to enable key-based (incl. FIDO/sk-*) login and agent forwarding via `ssh -A`.

publicKey.description: SSH public key line(s) to authorize. A public key is not a secret, so it is safe to hardcode. Use \n to separate multiple keys.

targetUser.description: User whose ~/.ssh/authorized_keys is written. 'automatic' resolves to _REMOTE_USER (the devcontainer's remote user, e.g. vscode).
